decisions.reason: It builds on the firm's drainage housing and installation know-how and is presented with its own product page.
Floor-level shower drainage is central to the firm's existing drainage systems and bathroom expertise.
As the flagship designer shower drainage product, it aligns directly with the firm's stated direction and design capabilities.
Integrated slope shower elements extend the firm's core drainage and installation knowledge toward accessible, low-profile solutions.
Backflow-protected basement floor drains leverage proven drainage technology and address technical installation challenges within the firm's core domain.
Air-admittance valves are less related to the firm's core drainage manufacturing and design knowledge, limiting its ability to interpret results and improve the product.
